result:
The fix is in, and `bun run typecheck` and `bun test` both pass (2 tests).

`PostController.index` in `app/Http/Controllers/PostController.ts` passed `page + 1` to `.paginate()`, so every request was shifted one page ahead of the one asked for. I changed it to pass `page` unchanged. `/posts` and `/posts?page=1` now show the 10 newest posts, and the pager, links and "from–to of total" numbers should now describe the page being shown. I didn't add a regression test, and I didn't load `/posts` to check the pager or the 25-post case.
